zh.title: 用粉笔在黑板上书写
zh.question: 人物用粉笔在黑板上书写或画线，整体交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察短粉笔的指间握持、手腕精细移动及抬臂协调，不规定文字内容。
zh.contact: 粉笔端与板面的接触和移动应与手部操作相关。
zh.object: 新增粉笔痕迹应与接触轨迹相联系，原有文字不作为当前书写成功的依据。
zh.aftermath: 若抬手、停笔或少量粉尘落下，观察接触解除和痕迹保留，不要求明显粉尘。
zh.unknown: 仅举粉笔准备，或实际接触与新增笔迹均不足以评价时选择无法判断。
scores: 人体、粉笔、板面及痕迹的可见关系整体严重不合理，或清楚显示没有书写。
书写尝试可辨认，但手部操作、粉笔接触与关键痕迹变化严重不符。
握持、接触或痕迹形成部分合理，同时有影响书写的明显异常。
主要书写、人体协调及粉笔与板面关系合理，仅有轻微局部异常。
实际书写可评价，人体、粉笔、板面、痕迹及可见停笔或粉尘运动协调，没有明显异常。

en.title: Write on a blackboard with chalk
en.question: How physically plausible is the interaction as the person writes or draws lines on the blackboard with chalk?
en.body: Consider fingertip grip on the short chalk, fine wrist motion, and raised-arm coordination. Specific text is not required.
en.contact: Chalk-end contact and movement should relate to hand operation.
en.object: New chalk traces should relate to the contact path. Existing text does not establish current writing success.
en.aftermath: If the hand lifts, writing stops, or dust falls, consider release and trace retention. Visible dust is not required.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if only chalk preparation is shown or neither actual contact nor new traces can be assessed.
scores: The person, chalk, board, and traces behave implausibly overall, or a clear view confirms no writing.
An attempt is recognizable, but hand operation, chalk contact, and key trace changes seriously disagree.
Some grip, contact, or trace formation is plausible, alongside clear anomalies affecting writing.
The main writing, body coordination, and chalk–board relation are plausible, with minor local anomalies.
Actual writing is assessable, and the person, chalk, board, traces, and visible stopping or dust motion are coherent without obvious anomalies.

zh.question: 人物用记号笔在白板上书写或画图，整体交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察握笔、手指和手腕控制及手臂导向，允许不同姿势和图形。
zh.contact: 笔尖与板面的接触及移动应与手的操作对应，板面支撑应保持可解释。
zh.object: 新增墨迹应与笔尖经过的位置相联系，已有图表或擦痕不代表当前操作已成功。
zh.aftermath: 若抬笔或停止，观察笔迹保留与接触解除，不要求板子变形或墨水滴落。
zh.unknown: 仅讲解或准备，或实际笔尖接触与新增墨迹均不足以评价时选择无法判断。
scores: 人体、记号笔、白板及墨迹的可见关系整体严重不合理，或清楚显示没有书写。
书写尝试可辨认，但手部导向、笔尖接触与关键墨迹变化严重不符。
握笔、接触或画线部分合理，同时有影响书写的明显异常。
主要书写、人体协调及笔迹与板面关系合理，仅有轻微局部异常。
实际书写可评价，人体、笔尖、白板和可见墨迹及停笔后状态协调，没有明显异常。

en.title: Write or draw on a whiteboard with a marker
en.question: How physically plausible is the interaction as the person writes or draws on the whiteboard with the marker?
en.body: Consider grip, finger–wrist control, and arm guidance. Postures and drawings may vary.
en.contact: Tip contact and motion should correspond to hand operation, with interpretable board support.
en.object: New ink should relate to regions passed by the tip. Existing charts or erasure marks do not establish current success.
en.aftermath: If the tip lifts or stops, consider mark retention and contact release. Board deformation or dripping is not required.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if only explanation or preparation is shown, or neither tip contact nor new ink can be assessed.
scores: The person, marker, board, and ink behave implausibly overall, or a clear view confirms no writing.
An attempt is recognizable, but hand guidance, tip contact, and key ink changes seriously disagree.
Some grip, contact, or drawing is plausible, alongside clear anomalies affecting writing.
The main writing, body coordination, and ink–board relation are plausible, with minor local anomalies.
Actual writing is assessable, and the person, tip, board, visible ink, and post-stop state are coherent without obvious anomalies.

zh.title: 用粉笔在黑板上书写
zh.question: 人物用粉笔在黑板上书写或画线，整体交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察短粉笔的指间握持、手腕精细移动及抬臂协调，不规定文字内容。
zh.contact: 粉笔端与板面的接触和移动应与手部操作相关。
zh.object: 新增粉笔痕迹应与接触轨迹相联系，原有文字不作为当前书写成功的依据。
zh.aftermath: 若抬手、停笔或少量粉尘落下，观察接触解除和痕迹保留，不要求明显粉尘。
zh.unknown: 仅举粉笔准备，或实际接触与新增笔迹均不足以评价时选择无法判断。
scores: 人体、粉笔、板面及痕迹的可见关系整体严重不合理，或清楚显示没有书写。
书写尝试可辨认，但手部操作、粉笔接触与关键痕迹变化严重不符。
握持、接触或痕迹形成部分合理，同时有影响书写的明显异常。
主要书写、人体协调及粉笔与板面关系合理，仅有轻微局部异常。
实际书写可评价，人体、粉笔、板面、痕迹及可见停笔或粉尘运动协调，没有明显异常。

en.title: Write on a blackboard with chalk
en.question: How physically plausible is the interaction as the person writes or draws lines on the blackboard with chalk?
en.body: Consider fingertip grip on the short chalk, fine wrist motion, and raised-arm coordination. Specific text is not required.
en.contact: Chalk-end contact and movement should relate to hand operation.
en.object: New chalk traces should relate to the contact path. Existing text does not establish current writing success.
en.aftermath: If the hand lifts, writing stops, or dust falls, consider release and trace retention. Visible dust is not required.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if only chalk preparation is shown or neither actual contact nor new traces can be assessed.
scores: The person, chalk, board, and traces behave implausibly overall, or a clear view confirms no writing.
An attempt is recognizable, but hand operation, chalk contact, and key trace changes seriously disagree.
Some grip, contact, or trace formation is plausible, alongside clear anomalies affecting writing.
The main writing, body coordination, and chalk–board relation are plausible, with minor local anomalies.
Actual writing is assessable, and the person, chalk, board, traces, and visible stopping or dust motion are coherent without obvious anomalies.
